### 去根号方法

考虑 $a,b,c,d>0$，证明 
$$
\sum_{\mathrm{cyc}}{\sqrt{\frac{a}{a+b+c}}\le \frac{4}{\sqrt{3}}}
$$
设 $\displaystyle w^2=\frac{3a}{a+b+c}$ 等，则有以下表示
$$
\begin{align*}
&(-w-x-y-z+4) \left(\sum _{4+4}  \text{poly}_0(\deg \to 8,\text{coeffs}\to \text{positive})\right) \\&= \sum _{4+4}  \left(-a w^2+3 a-b w^2-c w^2\right) \text{poly}_1(\deg \to 6,\text{coeffs}\to \text{positive})\\ &+\sum _{4+4}  (a-b)^2 \text{poly}_2(\deg \to 7,\text{coeffs}\to \text{positive})
\end{align*}
$$
